APPLIED ML / ENGINEERING PROJECT

Customer Churn Prediction

Understand risk before a customer leaves.

An end-to-end telecom churn application, from preprocessing and model training to a FastAPI prediction interface.

XGBoostFastAPIPandasScikit-learnTailwind CSS
View source on GitHub ↗

01 / THE PROBLEM

Why build it?

Customer data often spans demographics, subscriptions, and billing. A churn model needs a consistent representation of those inputs during training and prediction.

02 / THE IMPLEMENTATION

How it fits together.

The repository includes exploratory analysis, an XGBoost classifier, preprocessing utilities, and a FastAPI web application. The interface turns customer attributes into a model prediction.

  • End-to-end preprocessing and feature handling
  • XGBoost prediction pipeline
  • FastAPI backend and customer-input interface
Project context

Repository screenshot. Predictive results are experimental; no real-world retention uplift or causal effect is claimed.
